_**Addicted To Love**_ is the twelfth episode of _Glee: The New York Story'_ s third season. It premiered July 27, 2014.

## Synopsis[]
Artie takes advantage of his new 'ladies magnet' status at college with hopes of subtly getting Marley's attention, only to realize the repercussions of it when he ends up in a tight situation; Finn and Rachel volunteer at an animal shelter for _Funny Girl_ publicity, but when Finn falls in love with a dog and Rachel rebuffs the idea of having a pet, Finn sneaks the dog home and has everyone trying to hide Cory from Rachel; Blaine becomes immensely jealous when Kurt spends more time with Elliot. and begins to question Elliot's motives; The Breakfast Club and Pamela Landsbury team up for a gig to raise money for the hungry where Dani tries to make amends with Brittany.

## Plot[]
Artie Abrams struggles with loneliness and an unrequited crush on Marley Rose while working on a music video project for his film class. Marley visits him unexpectedly, and the two bond over a trip to see _22 Jump Street_, which sparks jealousy in Noah Puckerman when he learns about it. Puck becomes self-ware that Artie has a crush on Marley, which prompts him to confront Artie. Artie—unable to shake his feelings—begins sleeping around in an attempt to distract himself. This backfires when one of the girls falsely claims she is pregnant, leaving Artie in panic until Puck helps expose the lie and resolve the situation.
Meanwhile, the combined bands Pamela Lansbury and The Breakfast Club prepare for a Food Bank charity concert. Tensions rise when Puck notices Marley's growing closeness with Artie, leading to a heated argument in which Puck accuses Marley of favoring Artie. Marley reassures Puck of her love in an emotional moment, singing _Adore You_ to prove her devotion. Puck reveals he has been accepted to BMCC and plans to become a police officer, inspired by Marley, and she fully supports his dream.
Finn Hudson and Rachel Berry volunteer at an ASPCA event for _Funny Girl_ publicity. Finn bonds deeply with a shy Golden Retriever puppy named Cory, whose mother died of cancer, leaving him grieving. Finn secretly adopts Cory, causing a major fight when Rachel discovers him in their loft and demands he be returned. After learning Cory's heartbreaking backstory from the ASPCA manager, Rachel softens, accepts Cory, and begins treating him like family.
Blaine Anderson grows jealous of Kurt Hummel's friendship with Elliott Gilbert, fearing Kurt might leave him. After an argument, the two reconcile, and Blaine apologizes to Elliott. Meanwhile, Brittany and Dani bond over shared interests in mythical creatures while selecting a song for the charity concert.
The episode culminates in the Food Bank charity concert, where the bands deliver a high-energy performance of _Take Me Home Tonight_. The group celebrates the success, with donations totaling $50,000. Artie, still processing his feelings for Marley, performs a heartfelt solo rendition of _You're Beautiful,_ reflecting on his unrequited love as he begins moving forward.

Chunks: 0
Video 3
**“Crazy / U Drive Me Crazy”, Melissa Benoist & Jacob Artist (Marley & Jake, _GLEE_)**
I’ve never devoutly watched _Glee_ before, but I remember when it came out back in 2009, I watched the first 3 or so episodes and never got hooked. For some reason, I spent this past 3-day weekend on a catching-up-on-TV-shows spree and was feeling extra “musical” and decided to see what was going on in the _Glee_ world… (I follow Dianna Agron, who plays Quinn, on her blog _“You, Me & Charlie”_… I’ve always loved that girl!)
Apparently, the old gang graduated and is moving off into the bigger world of college, while new cast members have come into the _Glee_ club. I never thought I’d say it–but–I think I’m hooked into the show. The storylines seem super relateable now, as characters are now pushed into the real world, still fighting & figuring out what their dreams are and how to pursue them. A slap at real life and a slap at the effects those can take on your relationships. And, for once, I have a character I can somehow relate to! Melissa Benoist plays new-girl Marley, and, the second she stepped onto the show, there was a sweetness and genuineness I felt about her… and I absolutely _love_ her voice and style. And I’m so surprised at their eclectic song choices on the show… From Natalie Imbruglia’s “Torn” to freakin’ making my heart scream to Tears For Fears’ “Everybody Wants To Rule The World”? I’m freakin’ hooked.
It may sound cheesy, but shows like _GLEE_ inspire me once again. They make me want to embrace my free-loving musical spirit, bringing me back to what makes me the most happiest. It’s funny. When you spend so much time and attention away from the things you love, you get lost. And I’ve been feeling that way for a while now… What for rekindling what once was mine? For fostering that young hope again, and not growing too cold about the world? It was never bad to dream big at our age, so why stop?

texts.0: _**Addicted To Love**_ is the twelfth episode of _Glee: The New York Story'_ s third season. It premiered July 27, 2014.
texts.1:
## Synopsis[]
Artie takes advantage of his new 'ladies magnet' status at college with hopes of subtly getting Marley's attention, only to realize the repercussions of it when he ends up in a tight situation; Finn and Rachel volunteer at an animal shelter for _Funny Girl_ publicity, but when Finn falls in love with a dog and Rachel rebuffs the idea of having a pet, Finn sneaks the dog home and has everyone trying to hide Cory from Rachel; Blaine becomes immensely jealous when Kurt spends more time with Elliot. and begins to question Elliot's motives; The Breakfast Club and Pamela Landsbury team up for a gig to raise money for the hungry where Dani tries to make amends with Brittany.
texts.2:
## Plot[]
Artie Abrams struggles with loneliness and an unrequited crush on Marley Rose while working on a music video project for his film class. Marley visits him unexpectedly, and the two bond over a trip to see _22 Jump Street_, which sparks jealousy in Noah Puckerman when he learns about it. Puck becomes self-ware that Artie has a crush on Marley, which prompts him to confront Artie. Artie—unable to shake his feelings—begins sleeping around in an attempt to distract himself. This backfires when one of the girls falsely claims she is pregnant, leaving Artie in panic until Puck helps expose the lie and resolve the situation.
Meanwhile, the combined bands Pamela Lansbury and The Breakfast Club prepare for a Food Bank charity concert. Tensions rise when Puck notices Marley's growing closeness with Artie, leading to a heated argument in which Puck accuses Marley of favoring Artie. Marley reassures Puck of her love in an emotional moment, singing _Adore You_ to prove her devotion. Puck reveals he has been accepted to BMCC and plans to become a police officer, inspired by Marley, and she fully supports his dream.
Finn Hudson and Rachel Berry volunteer at an ASPCA event for _Funny Girl_ publicity. Finn bonds deeply with a shy Golden Retriever puppy named Cory, whose mother died of cancer, leaving him grieving. Finn secretly adopts Cory, causing a major fight when Rachel discovers him in their loft and demands he be returned. After learning Cory's heartbreaking backstory from the ASPCA manager, Rachel softens, accepts Cory, and begins treating him like family.
Blaine Anderson grows jealous of Kurt Hummel's friendship with Elliott Gilbert, fearing Kurt might leave him. After an argument, the two reconcile, and Blaine apologizes to Elliott. Meanwhile, Brittany and Dani bond over shared interests in mythical creatures while selecting a song for the charity concert.
The episode culminates in the Food Bank charity concert, where the bands deliver a high-energy performance of _Take Me Home Tonight_. The group celebrates the success, with donations totaling $50,000. Artie, still processing his feelings for Marley, performs a heartfelt solo rendition of _You're Beautiful,_ reflecting on his unrequited love as he begins moving forward.

**“Crazy / U Drive Me Crazy”, Melissa Benoist & Jacob Artist (Marley & Jake, _GLEE_)**
I’ve never devoutly watched _Glee_ before, but I remember when it came out back in 2009, I watched the first 3 or so episodes and never got hooked. For some reason, I spent this past 3-day weekend on a catching-up-on-TV-shows spree and was feeling extra “musical” and decided to see what was going on in the _Glee_ world… (I follow Dianna Agron, who plays Quinn, on her blog _“You, Me & Charlie”_… I’ve always loved that girl!)
Apparently, the old gang graduated and is moving off into the bigger world of college, while new cast members have come into the _Glee_ club. I never thought I’d say it–but–I think I’m hooked into the show. The storylines seem super relateable now, as characters are now pushed into the real world, still fighting & figuring out what their dreams are and how to pursue them. A slap at real life and a slap at the effects those can take on your relationships. And, for once, I have a character I can somehow relate to! Melissa Benoist plays new-girl Marley, and, the second she stepped onto the show, there was a sweetness and genuineness I felt about her… and I absolutely _love_ her voice and style. And I’m so surprised at their eclectic song choices on the show… From Natalie Imbruglia’s “Torn” to freakin’ making my heart scream to Tears For Fears’ “Everybody Wants To Rule The World”? I’m freakin’ hooked.
It may sound cheesy, but shows like _GLEE_ inspire me once again. They make me want to embrace my free-loving musical spirit, bringing me back to what makes me the most happiest. It’s funny. When you spend so much time and attention away from the things you love, you get lost. And I’ve been feeling that way for a while now… What for rekindling what once was mine? For fostering that young hope again, and not growing too cold about the world? It was never bad to dream big at our age, so why stop?

_**Addicted To Love**_ is the twelfth episode of _Glee: The New York Story'_ s third season. It premiered July 27, 2014.

## Synopsis[]
Artie takes advantage of his new 'ladies magnet' status at college with hopes of subtly getting Marley's attention, only to realize the repercussions of it when he ends up in a tight situation; Finn and Rachel volunteer at an animal shelter for _Funny Girl_ publicity, but when Finn falls in love with a dog and Rachel rebuffs the idea of having a pet, Finn sneaks the dog home and has everyone trying to hide Cory from Rachel; Blaine becomes immensely jealous when Kurt spends more time with Elliot. and begins to question Elliot's motives; The Breakfast Club and Pamela Landsbury team up for a gig to raise money for the hungry where Dani tries to make amends with Brittany.

## Plot[]
Artie Abrams struggles with loneliness and an unrequited crush on Marley Rose while working on a music video project for his film class. Marley visits him unexpectedly, and the two bond over a trip to see _22 Jump Street_, which sparks jealousy in Noah Puckerman when he learns about it. Puck becomes self-ware that Artie has a crush on Marley, which prompts him to confront Artie. Artie—unable to shake his feelings—begins sleeping around in an attempt to distract himself. This backfires when one of the girls falsely claims she is pregnant, leaving Artie in panic until Puck helps expose the lie and resolve the situation.
Meanwhile, the combined bands Pamela Lansbury and The Breakfast Club prepare for a Food Bank charity concert. Tensions rise when Puck notices Marley's growing closeness with Artie, leading to a heated argument in which Puck accuses Marley of favoring Artie. Marley reassures Puck of her love in an emotional moment, singing _Adore You_ to prove her devotion. Puck reveals he has been accepted to BMCC and plans to become a police officer, inspired by Marley, and she fully supports his dream.
Finn Hudson and Rachel Berry volunteer at an ASPCA event for _Funny Girl_ publicity. Finn bonds deeply with a shy Golden Retriever puppy named Cory, whose mother died of cancer, leaving him grieving. Finn secretly adopts Cory, causing a major fight when Rachel discovers him in their loft and demands he be returned. After learning Cory's heartbreaking backstory from the ASPCA manager, Rachel softens, accepts Cory, and begins treating him like family.
Blaine Anderson grows jealous of Kurt Hummel's friendship with Elliott Gilbert, fearing Kurt might leave him. After an argument, the two reconcile, and Blaine apologizes to Elliott. Meanwhile, Brittany and Dani bond over shared interests in mythical creatures while selecting a song for the charity concert.
The episode culminates in the Food Bank charity concert, where the bands deliver a high-energy performance of _Take Me Home Tonight_. The group celebrates the success, with donations totaling $50,000. Artie, still processing his feelings for Marley, performs a heartfelt solo rendition of _You're Beautiful,_ reflecting on his unrequited love as he begins moving forward.

**“Crazy / U Drive Me Crazy”, Melissa Benoist & Jacob Artist (Marley & Jake, _GLEE_)**
I’ve never devoutly watched _Glee_ before, but I remember when it came out back in 2009, I watched the first 3 or so episodes and never got hooked. For some reason, I spent this past 3-day weekend on a catching-up-on-TV-shows spree and was feeling extra “musical” and decided to see what was going on in the _Glee_ world… (I follow Dianna Agron, who plays Quinn, on her blog _“You, Me & Charlie”_… I’ve always loved that girl!)
Apparently, the old gang graduated and is moving off into the bigger world of college, while new cast members have come into the _Glee_ club. I never thought I’d say it–but–I think I’m hooked into the show. The storylines seem super relateable now, as characters are now pushed into the real world, still fighting & figuring out what their dreams are and how to pursue them. A slap at real life and a slap at the effects those can take on your relationships. And, for once, I have a character I can somehow relate to! Melissa Benoist plays new-girl Marley, and, the second she stepped onto the show, there was a sweetness and genuineness I felt about her… and I absolutely _love_ her voice and style. And I’m so surprised at their eclectic song choices on the show… From Natalie Imbruglia’s “Torn” to freakin’ making my heart scream to Tears For Fears’ “Everybody Wants To Rule The World”? I’m freakin’ hooked.
It may sound cheesy, but shows like _GLEE_ inspire me once again. They make me want to embrace my free-loving musical spirit, bringing me back to what makes me the most happiest. It’s funny. When you spend so much time and attention away from the things you love, you get lost. And I’ve been feeling that way for a while now… What for rekindling what once was mine? For fostering that young hope again, and not growing too cold about the world? It was never bad to dream big at our age, so why stop?
